scope: Bounded AC1027 TABLECONTENT per-value content-format transport in ASCII and binary DXF.

specification.basis: Group 90 content-property mask admits the content-format bits through 0x100; group 91 is the auto-scale property bit; groups 92/93 are value data/unit types; groups 300, 40, 140, 94, 62/420, 340, and 144 carry format string, rotation, block scale, alignment, color, text-style handle, and text height. This receipt establishes serialized field transport only.

admission.propertyFlagsMask: 0x000..0x100 and must be selected by propertyOverrideMask
admission.contentColor: ACI 0..256 with optional group-420 true color 0..0xffffff; named CMC strings remain refused
admission.textStyleHandle: 0 only; unresolved nonzero references remain refused
admission.rotationBlockScaleAndHeight: finite; text height must be nonnegative
admission.aggregatePayloadTextBudget: Content strings plus format strings remain bounded by the DXF binary payload cap

output.typedReadback: All admitted profile fields above match the retained content-format metadata at ordinal 2. The output also retains the separate alignment-only profile from RPP-5ya.

negativeControls.result: Refusal preserves the sentinel destination; restoring alignment 2 permits same-writer retry.

negativeControls.mutation: Set group-90 property override mask to cell-style-only bit 0x200.
negativeControls.result: Refusal preserves the sentinel destination; restoring the selected content mask permits same-writer retry.

limitations: No AutoCAD/ODA native layout or rendering result is asserted.
Nonzero text-style handles, named CMC color fields, cell attributes, TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP dependencies, units/margins/borders, and other unqualified source profiles remain refused or unqualified.
This is not complete TABLECONTENT or whole-document conversion evidence.
